The ones which are over stay reachable behind one click, because their rooms keep the chat and the\n *       materials of the workshop which was held in them.\n */\nexport function OnlineWorkshopRoomTermPicker({\n    terms,\n    selectedTermSlug,\n    onSelectTerm,\n    currentTime,\n}: OnlineWorkshopRoomTermPickerProps) {\n    const pastTermsListId = useId();\n    const termsByPhase = useMemo(\n        () => groupWorkshopsByPhase(terms, Date.parse(currentTime)),\n        [currentTime, terms],\n    );\n    const currentTerms = [...termsByPhase.ongoing, ...termsByPhase.upcoming];\n    const { past: pastTerms } = termsByPhase;\n    const isSelectedTermPast = pastTerms.some((term) => term.slug === selectedTermSlug);\n\n    // Note: A participant who came for a workshop which is already over meets the history open, so the term they came\n    //       for is where they can see it. That is asked about the workshop the room was entered with rather than kept\n    //       in step with the choice, because from then on it is the participant who opens and closes the history.\n    const [isPastTermsShown, setIsPastTermsShown] = useState(isSelectedTermPast);\n\n    return (\n        <fieldset className=\"min-w-0\">\n            <legend className=\"text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-slate-400\">\n                {ONLINE_WORKSHOP_ROOM_TERM_PICKER_COPY.legend}\n            </legend>\n            <p className=\"mt-1 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500\">{ONLINE_WORKSHOP_ROOM_TERM_PICKER_COPY.description}</p>\n\n            {currentTerms.length === 0 ? (\n                <p className=\"mt-3 rounded-lg border border-dashed border-white/15 bg-white/[0.025] px-3 py-3 text-xs text-slate-400\">\n                    {ONLINE_WORKSHOP_ROOM_TERM_PICKER_COPY.noCurrentTermsMessage}\n                </p>\n            ) : (\n                <EventTermOptionList\n                    terms={currentTerms}\n                    selectedTermSlug={selectedTermSlug}\n                    onSelectTerm={onSelectTerm}\n                    currentTime={currentTime}\n                    isTopicShown={true}\n                    appearance=\"dark\"\n                    density=\"compact\"\n                    noteIcon={Clock}\n                    createNoteText={createOnlineWorkshopTermNoteText}\n                    className=\"mt-3\"\n                />\n            )}\n\n            {pastTerms.length > 0 && (\n                <>\n                    <button\n                        type=\"button\"\n                        aria-controls={pastTermsListId}\n                        aria-expanded={isPastTermsShown}\n                        onClick={() => setIsPastTermsShown((isShown) => !isShown)}\n                        className=\"mt-3 flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-lg px-1 py-1.5 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 transition-colors hover:text-slate-300\"\n                    >\n                        {ONLINE_WORKSHOP_ROOM_TERM_PICKER_COPY.pastTermsLabel} ({pastTerms.length})\n                        <ChevronDown\n                            className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 transition-transform ${isPastTermsShown ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`}\n                            aria-hidden=\"true\"\n                        />\n                    </button>\n                    {isPastTermsShown && (\n );\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":4,"oldLines":7,"newStart":4,"newLines":7,"lines":[" import { EventTermOptionList } from '@/components/events/EventTermOptionList';"," import type { participant is choosing which workshop to enter\n */\nconst ONLINE_WORKSHOP_ROOM_TERM_PICKER_COPY = {\n    legend: 'Vyberte si workshop',\n    description: 'Do místnosti kteréhokoli workshopu se That is asked about the workshop the room was entered with rather than kept\n    //       in step with the choice, because from then on it is the participant who opens and closes the history.\n    const [isPastTermsShown, setIsPastTermsShown] = useState(isSelectedTermPast);\n\n    return (\n        <fieldset className=\"min-w-0\">\n            <legend className=\"text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-slate-400\">\n                {ONLINE_WORKSHOP_ROOM_TERM_PICKER_COPY.legend}\n            </legend>\n            <p className=\"mt-1 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500\">{ONLINE_WORKSHOP_ROOM_TERM_PICKER_COPY.description}</p>\n\n            {currentTerms.length === 0 ? (\n                <p className=\"mt-3 rounded-lg border border-dashed border-white/15 bg-white/[0.025] px-3 py-3 text-xs text-slate-400\">\n                    {ONLINE_WORKSHOP_ROOM_TERM_PICKER_COPY.noCurrentTermsMessage}\n                </p>\n            ) : (\n                <EventTermOptionList\n                    terms={currentTerms}\n                    selectedTermSlug={selectedTermSlug}\n                    onSelectTerm={onSelectTerm}\n                    currentTime={currentTime}\n                    isTopicShown={true}\n                    appearance=\"dark\"\n                    density=\"compact\"\n                    noteIcon={Clock}\n                    createNoteText={createOnlineWorkshopTermNoteText}\n                    className=\"mt-3\"\n                />\n            )}\n\n            {pastTerms.length > 0 && (\n                <>\n                    <button\n                        type=\"button\"\n                        aria-controls={pastTermsListId}\n                        aria-expanded={isPastTermsShown}\n                        onClick={() => setIsPastTermsShown((isShown) => !isShown)}\n                        className=\"mt-3 flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-lg px-1 py-1.5 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 transition-colors hover:text-slate-300\"\n                    >\n                        {ONLINE_WORKSHOP_ROOM_TERM_PICKER_COPY.pastTermsLabel} ({pastTerms.length})\n                        <ChevronDown\n                            className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 transition-transform ${isPastTermsShown ? );\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":63,"oldLines":6,"newStart":63,"newLines":7,"lines":["         [currentTime, terms],","     );","     const currentTerms = [...termsByPhase.ongoing, > 0 && (","originalFile":"'use client';\n\nimport { createOnlineWorkshopTermNoteText } from '@/businesses/online-workshop/onlineWorkshopTerms';\nimport { EventTermOptionList } from '@/components/events/EventTermOptionList';\nimport type { EventOccurrence } from '@/lib/events/eventOccurrence';\nimport { groupWorkshopsByPhase } from '@/lib/workshops/workshopPhase';\nimport { ChevronDown, Clock, History, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';\nimport { useId, useMemo, useState } from 'react';\n\n/**\n * What the waiting room says while a participant is choosing which workshop to enter\n */\nconst ONLINE_WORKSHOP_ROOM_TERM_PICKER_COPY = {\n    legend: 'Vyberte si workshop',\n    description: 'Do místnosti kteréhokoli workshopu se dostanete stejným jménem a e-mailem.',\n    noCurrentTermsMessage: 'Právě teď žádný workshop neběží a další termín zatím není vypsaný.',\n    freshlyPastTermsLabel: 'Právě proběhlo',\n    pastTermsLabel: 'Proběhlé workshopy',\n\n    /**\n     * Note: A workshop which has only just been held promises exactly what any finished one does, and says only that\n     *       it was now — what a participant came back for is waiting behind the very same open door.\n     */\n    freshlyPastTermNoteText: 'Právě skončil, místnost zůstává otevřená',\n\n    /**\n     * Note: A room which is over is worth entering for what stayed in it, and that is all this promises. What a\n     *       recording or a paid material asks for is decided by the room itself once a participant is inside.\n     */\n    pastTermNoteText: 'Místnost zůstává otevřená',\n} as const;\n\ntype OnlineWorkshopRoomTermPickerProps = {\n    readonly terms: readonly EventOccurrence[];\n    readonly selectedTermSlug: string;\n    readonly onSelectTerm: (term: EventOccurrence) => void;\n\n    /**\n     * Moment which decides what is running, what is ahead, and what is already over\n     *\n     * Note: That moment comes from the server which listed these terms, so the browser groups them exactly as the\n     *       page it received was built, rather than regrouping them the instant it hydrates.\n     */\n    readonly currentTime: string;\n};\n\n/**\n * Every published term of the online workshop, offered to a participant who has not connected to one yet\n *\n * Note: A workshop which runs right now or is still ahead is what a participant is nearly always looking for, so those\n *       terms lead. The ones which are over stay reachable behind one click, because their rooms keep the chat and the\n *       materials of the workshop which was held in them.\n */\nexport function OnlineWorkshopRoomTermPicker({\n    terms,\n    selectedTermSlug,\n    onSelectTerm,\n    currentTime,\n}: OnlineWorkshopRoomTermPickerProps) {\n    const pastTermsListId = useId();\n    const termsByPhase = useMemo(\n        () => groupWorkshopsByPhase(terms, Date.parse(currentTime)),\n        [currentTime, terms],\n    );\n    const currentTerms = [...termsByPhase.ongoing, ...termsByPhase.upcoming];\n    const freshlyPastTerms = termsByPhase['freshly-past'];\n    const { past: pastTerms } = termsByPhase;\n    const isSelectedTermPast = pastTerms.some((term) => term.slug === selectedTermSlug);\n\n    // Note: A participant who came for a workshop which is already over meets the history open, so the term they came\n    //       for is where they can see it. That is asked about the workshop the room was entered with rather than kept\n    //       in step with the choice, because from then on it is the participant who opens and closes the history.\n    const [isPastTermsShown, setIsPastTermsShown] = useState(isSelectedTermPast);\n\n    // Note: Which term is chosen, which moment the terms are placed against, and how much room a card is given is one\n    //       and the same question for every group this picker offers, so each of them is laid out by the very same\n    //       description of a list and adds nothing but its own terms and its own note.\n    const sharedTermOptionListProps = {\n        selectedTermSlug,\n        onSelectTerm,\n        currentTime,\n        isTopicShown: true,\n        appearance: 'dark',\n        density: 'compact',\n    } as const;\n\n    return (\n        <fieldset className=\"min-w-0\">\n            <legend className=\"text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-slate-400\">\n                {ONLINE_WORKSHOP_ROOM_TERM_PICKER_COPY.legend}\n            </legend>\n            <p className=\"mt-1 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500\">{ONLINE_WORKSHOP_ROOM_TERM_PICKER_COPY.description}</p>\n\n            {currentTerms.length === 0 ? (\n                <p className=\"mt-3 rounded-lg border border-dashed border-white/15 bg-white/[0.025] px-3 py-3 text-xs text-slate-400\">\n                    {ONLINE_WORKSHOP_ROOM_TERM_PICKER_COPY.noCurrentTermsMessage}\n                </p>\n            ) : (\n                <EventTermOptionList\n                    terms={currentTerms}\n                    selectedTermSlug={selectedTermSlug}\n                    onSelectTerm={onSelectTerm}\n                    currentTime={currentTime}\n                    isTopicShown={true}\n                    appearance=\"dark\"\n                    density=\"compact\"\n                    noteIcon={Clock}\n                    createNoteText={createOnlineWorkshopTermNoteText}\n                    className=\"mt-3\"\n                />\n            )}\n\n            {pastTerms.length > 0 && (\n                <>\n                    <button\n                        type=\"button\"\n                        aria-controls={pastTermsListId}\n                        aria-expanded={isPastTermsShown}\n                        onClick={() => setIsPastTermsShown((isShown) => !isShown)}\n                        className=\"mt-3 flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-lg px-1 py-1.5 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 transition-colors hover:text-slate-300\"\n                    >\n                        {ONLINE_WORKSHOP_ROOM_TERM_PICKER_COPY.pastTermsLabel} ({pastTerms.length})\n                        <ChevronDown\n                            className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 transition-transform ${isPastTermsShown ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`}\n                            aria-hidden=\"true\"\n                        />\n                    </button>\n                    {isPastTermsShown && (\n                        <EventTermOptionList\n                            id={pastTermsListId}\n                            terms={pastTerms}\n                            selectedTermSlug={selectedTermSlug}\n                            onSelectTerm={onSelectTerm}\n                            currentTime={currentTime}\n                            isTopicShown={true}\n                            appearance=\"dark\"\n                            density=\"compact\"\n                            noteIcon={History}\n                            createNoteText={() => ONLINE_WORKSHOP_ROOM_TERM_PICKER_COPY.pastTermNoteText}\n                            className=\"mt-1\"\n                        />\n                    )}\n                </>\n            )}\n        </fieldset>\n    );\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":97,"oldLines":19,"newStart":97,"newLines":29,"lines":["                 </p>","             ) : (","                 <EventTermOptionList","+ '@/lib/events/eventOccurrence';\nimport { groupWorkshopsByPhase } from '@/lib/workshops/workshopPhase';\nimport { ChevronDown, Clock, History, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';\nimport { useId, useMemo, useState } from 'react';\n\n/**\n * What the waiting room says while a participant is choosing which workshop to enter\n */\nconst ONLINE_WORKSHOP_ROOM_TERM_PICKER_COPY = {\n    legend: 'Vyberte si workshop',\n    description: 'Do místnosti kteréhokoli workshopu se dostanete stejným jménem a e-mailem.',\n    noCurrentTermsMessage: 'Právě teď žádný workshop neběží a další termín zatím není vypsaný.',\n    freshlyPastTermsLabel: 'Právě proběhlo',\n    pastTermsLabel: 'Proběhlé workshopy',\n\n    /**\n     * Note: A workshop which has only just been held promises exactly what any finished one does, and says only that\n     *       it was now — what a participant came back for is waiting behind the very same open door.\n     */\n    freshlyPastTermNoteText: 'Právě skončil, místnost zůstává otevřená',\n\n    /**\n     * Note: A room which is over is worth entering for what stayed in it, and that is all this promises. What a\n     *       recording or a paid material asks for is decided by the room itself once a participant is inside.\n     */\n    pastTermNoteText: 'Místnost zůstává otevřená',\n} as const;\n\ntype OnlineWorkshopRoomTermPickerProps = {\n    readonly terms: readonly EventOccurrence[];\n    readonly selectedTermSlug: string;\n    readonly onSelectTerm: (term: EventOccurrence) => void;\n\n    /**\n     * Moment which decides what is running, what is ahead, and what is already over\n     *\n     * Note: That moment comes from the server which listed these terms, so the browser groups them exactly as the\n     *       page it received was built, rather than regrouping them the instant it hydrates.\n     */\n    readonly currentTime: string;\n};\n\n/**\n * Every published term of the online workshop, offered to a participant who has not connected to one yet\n *\n * Note: A workshop which runs right now or is still ahead is what a participant is nearly always looking for, so those\n *       terms lead. The ones which are over stay reachable behind one click, because their rooms keep the chat and the\n *       materials of the workshop which was held in them.\n */\nexport function OnlineWorkshopRoomTermPicker({\n    terms,\n    selectedTermSlug,\n    onSelectTerm,\n    currentTime,\n}: OnlineWorkshopRoomTermPickerProps) {\n    const pastTermsListId = useId();\n    const termsByPhase = useMemo(\n        () => groupWorkshopsByPhase(terms, Date.parse(currentTime)),\n        [currentTime, terms],\n    );\n    const currentTerms = [...termsByPhase.ongoing, ...termsByPhase.upcoming];\n    const freshlyPastTerms = termsByPhase['freshly-past'];\n    const { past: pastTerms } = termsByPhase;\n    const isSelectedTermPast = pastTerms.some((term) => term.slug === selectedTermSlug);\n\n    // Note: A participant who came for a workshop which is already over meets the history open, so the term they came\n    //       for is where they can see it. That is asked about the workshop the room was entered with rather than kept\n    //       in step with the choice, because from then on it is the participant who opens and closes the history.\n    const [isPastTermsShown, setIsPastTermsShown] = useState(isSelectedTermPast);\n\n    // Note: Which term is chosen, which moment the terms are placed against, and how much room a card is given is one\n    //       and the same question for every group this picker offers, so each of them is laid out by the very same\n    //       description of a list and adds nothing but its own terms and its own note.\n    const sharedTermOptionListProps = {\n        selectedTermSlug,\n        onSelectTerm,\n        currentTime,\n        isTopicShown: true,\n        appearance: 'dark',\n        density: 'compact',\n    } as const;\n\n    return (\n        <fieldset className=\"min-w-0\">\n            <legend className=\"text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-slate-400\">\n                {ONLINE_WORKSHOP_ROOM_TERM_PICKER_COPY.legend}\n            </legend>\n            <p className=\"mt-1 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500\">{ONLINE_WORKSHOP_ROOM_TERM_PICKER_COPY.description}</p>\n\n            {currentTerms.length === 0 ? (\n                <p className=\"mt-3 rounded-lg border border-dashed border-white/15 bg-white/[0.025] px-3 py-3 text-xs text-slate-400\">\n                    {ONLINE_WORKSHOP_ROOM_TERM_PICKER_COPY.noCurrentTermsMessage}\n                </p>\n            ) : (\n                <EventTermOptionList\n                    {...sharedTermOptionListProps}\n                    terms={currentTerms}\n                    noteIcon={Clock}\n                    createNoteText={createOnlineWorkshopTermNoteText}\n                    className=\"mt-3\"\n                />\n            )}\n\n            {freshlyPastTerms.length > 0 && (\n                <>\n                    <p className=\"mt-3 px-1 text-xs font-semibold text-amber-200\">\n                        {ONLINE_WORKSHOP_ROOM_TERM_PICKER_COPY.freshlyPastTermsLabel} ({freshlyPastTerms.length})\n                    </p>\n                    <EventTermOptionList\n                        {...sharedTermOptionListProps}\n                        terms={freshlyPastTerms}\n                        noteIcon={Sparkles}\n                        createNoteText={() => ONLINE_WORKSHOP_ROOM_TERM_PICKER_COPY.freshlyPastTermNoteText}\n                        className=\"mt-1\"\n                    />\n                </>\n            )}\n\n            {pastTerms.length > 0 && (\n                <>\n                    <button\n                        type=\"button\"\n                        aria-controls={pastTermsListId}\n                        aria-expanded={isPastTermsShown}\n                        onClick={() => setIsPastTermsShown((isShown) => !isShown)}\n                        className=\"mt-3 flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-lg px-1 py-1.5 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 transition-colors hover:text-slate-300\"\n                    >\n                        {ONLINE_WORKSHOP_ROOM_TERM_PICKER_COPY.pastTermsLabel} ({pastTerms.length})\n                        <ChevronDown\n                            className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 transition-transform ${isPastTermsShown ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`}\n                            aria-hidden=\"true\"\n                        />\n                    </button>\n                    {isPastTermsShown && (\n                        <EventTermOptionList\n                            id={pastTermsListId}\n                            terms={pastTerms}\n                            selectedTermSlug={selectedTermSlug}\n                            onSelectTerm={onSelectTerm}\n                            currentTime={currentTime}\n                            isTopicShown={true}\n                            appearance=\"dark\"\n                            density=\"compact\"\n                            noteIcon={History}\n                            createNoteText={() => ONLINE_WORKSHOP_ROOM_TERM_PICKER_COPY.pastTermNoteText}\n                            className=\"mt-1\"\n                        />\n                    )}\n                </>\n            )}\n        </fieldset>\n    );\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":137,"oldLines":14,"newStart":137,"newLines":9,"lines":["                     </button>","                     {isPastTermsShown && (","                         <EventTermOptionList","+                            {...sharedTermOptionListProps}","                             id={pastTermsListId}","                             terms={pastTerms}","-                            selectedTermSlug={selectedTermSlug}","-                            onSelectTerm={onSelectTerm}","-                            currentTime={currentTime}","-                            isTopicShown={true}","-                            appearance=\"dark\"","-                            density=\"compact\"","                             noteIcon={History}","                             createNoteText={() => ONLINE_WORKSHOP_ROOM_TERM_PICKER_COPY.pastTermNoteText}","                             className=\"mt-1\""]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

Somebody\n *       who was at it last night comes back for what stayed in its room, and asking them to unfold the whole history\n *       to find the workshop they have just left would hide it among the terms they are not looking for at all.\n */","originalFile":"'use client';\n\nimport { createOnlineWorkshopTermNoteText } from '@/businesses/online-workshop/onlineWorkshopTerms';\nimport { EventTermOptionList } from '@/components/events/EventTermOptionList';\nimport type { EventOccurrence } from '@/lib/events/eventOccurrence';\nimport { groupWorkshopsByPhase } from '@/lib/workshops/workshopPhase';\nimport { ChevronDown, Clock, History, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';\nimport { useId, useMemo, useState } from 'react';\n\n/**\n * What the waiting room says while a participant is choosing which workshop to enter\n */\nconst ONLINE_WORKSHOP_ROOM_TERM_PICKER_COPY = {\n    legend: 'Vyberte si workshop',\n    description: 'Do místnosti kteréhokoli workshopu se dostanete stejným jménem a e-mailem.',\n    noCurrentTermsMessage: 'Právě teď žádný workshop neběží a další termín zatím není vypsaný.',\n    freshlyPastTermsLabel: 'Právě proběhlo',\n    pastTermsLabel: 'Proběhlé workshopy',\n\n    /**\n     * Note: A workshop which has only just been held promises exactly what any finished one does, and says only that\n     *       it was now — what a participant came back for is waiting behind the very same open door.\n     */\n    freshlyPastTermNoteText: 'Právě skončil, místnost zůstává otevřená',\n\n    /**\n     * Note: A room which is over is worth entering for what stayed in it, and that is all this promises. What a\n     *       recording or a paid material asks for is decided by the room itself once a participant is inside.\n     */\n    pastTermNoteText: 'Místnost zůstává otevřená',\n} as const;\n\ntype OnlineWorkshopRoomTermPickerProps = {\n    readonly terms: readonly EventOccurrence[];\n    readonly selectedTermSlug: string;\n    readonly onSelectTerm: (term: EventOccurrence) => void;\n\n    /**\n     * Moment which decides what is running, what is ahead, and what is already over\n     *\n     * Note: That moment comes from the server which listed these terms, so the browser groups them exactly as the\n     *       page it received was built, rather than regrouping them the instant it hydrates.\n     */\n    readonly currentTime: string;\n};\n\n/**\n * Every published term of the online workshop, offered to a participant who has not connected to one yet\n *\n * Note: A workshop which runs right now or is still ahead is what a participant is nearly always looking for, so those\n *       terms lead. The ones which are over stay reachable behind one click, because their rooms keep the chat and the\n *       materials of the workshop which was held in them.\n */\nexport function OnlineWorkshopRoomTermPicker({\n    terms,\n    selectedTermSlug,\n    onSelectTerm,\n    currentTime,\n}: OnlineWorkshopRoomTermPickerProps) {\n    const pastTermsListId = useId();\n    const termsByPhase = useMemo(\n        () => groupWorkshopsByPhase(terms, Date.parse(currentTime)),\n        [currentTime, terms],\n    );\n    const currentTerms = [...termsByPhase.ongoing, ...termsByPhase.upcoming];\n    const freshlyPastTerms = termsByPhase['freshly-past'];\n    const { past: pastTerms } = termsByPhase;\n    const isSelectedTermPast = pastTerms.some((term) => term.slug === selectedTermSlug);\n\n    // Note: A participant who came for a workshop which is already over meets the history open, so the term they came\n    //       for is where they can see it. That is asked about the workshop the room was entered with rather than kept\n    //       in step with the choice, because from then on it is the participant who opens and closes the history.\n    const [isPastTermsShown, setIsPastTermsShown] = useState(isSelectedTermPast);\n\n    // Note: Which term is chosen, which moment the terms are placed against, and how much room a card is given is one\n    //       and the same question for every group this picker offers, so each of them is laid out by the very same\n    //       description of a list and adds nothing but its own terms and its own note.\n    const sharedTermOptionListProps = {\n        selectedTermSlug,\n        onSelectTerm,\n        currentTime,\n        isTopicShown: true,\n        appearance: 'dark',\n        density: 'compact',\n    } as const;\n\n    return (\n        <fieldset className=\"min-w-0\">\n            <legend className=\"text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-slate-400\">\n                {ONLINE_WORKSHOP_ROOM_TERM_PICKER_COPY.legend}\n            </legend>\n            <p className=\"mt-1 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500\">{ONLINE_WORKSHOP_ROOM_TERM_PICKER_COPY.description}</p>\n\n            {currentTerms.length === 0 ? (\n                <p className=\"mt-3 rounded-lg border border-dashed border-white/15 bg-white/[0.025] px-3 py-3 text-xs text-slate-400\">\n                    {ONLINE_WORKSHOP_ROOM_TERM_PICKER_COPY.noCurrentTermsMessage}\n                </p>\n            ) : (\n                <EventTermOptionList\n                    {...sharedTermOptionListProps}\n                    terms={currentTerms}\n                    noteIcon={Clock}\n                    createNoteText={createOnlineWorkshopTermNoteText}\n                    className=\"mt-3\"\n                />\n            )}\n\n            {freshlyPastTerms.length > 0 && (\n                <>\n                    <p className=\"mt-3 px-1 text-xs font-semibold text-amber-200\">\n                        {ONLINE_WORKSHOP_ROOM_TERM_PICKER_COPY.freshlyPastTermsLabel} ({freshlyPastTerms.length})\n                    </p>\n                    <EventTermOptionList\n                        {...sharedTermOptionListProps}\n                        terms={freshlyPastTerms}\n                        noteIcon={Sparkles}\n                        createNoteText={() => ONLINE_WORKSHOP_ROOM_TERM_PICKER_COPY.freshlyPastTermNoteText}\n                        className=\"mt-1\"\n                    />\n                </>\n            )}\n\n            {pastTerms.length > 0 && (\n                <>\n                    <button\n                        type=\"button\"\n                        aria-controls={pastTermsListId}\n                        aria-expanded={isPastTermsShown}\n                        onClick={() => setIsPastTermsShown((isShown) => !isShown)}\n                        className=\"mt-3 flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-lg px-1 py-1.5 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 transition-colors hover:text-slate-300\"\n                    >\n                        {ONLINE_WORKSHOP_ROOM_TERM_PICKER_COPY.pastTermsLabel} ({pastTerms.length})\n                        <ChevronDown\n                            className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 transition-transform ${isPastTermsShown ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`}\n                            aria-hidden=\"true\"\n                        />\n                    </button>\n                    {isPastTermsShown && (\n                        <EventTermOptionList\n                            {...sharedTermOptionListProps}\n                            id={pastTermsListId}\n                            terms={pastTerms}\n                            noteIcon={History}\n                            createNoteText={() => ONLINE_WORKSHOP_ROOM_TERM_PICKER_COPY.pastTermNoteText}\n                            className=\"mt-1\"\n                        />\n                    )}\n                </>\n            )}\n        </fieldset>\n    );\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":50,"oldLines":6,"newStart":50,"newLines":9,"lines":["  * Note: A workshop which runs right now or is still ahead is what a participant is nearly always looking for, so those","  *       terms lead. Somebody","+ *       who was at it last night comes back for what stayed in its room, and asking them to unfold the whole history","+ *       to find the workshop they have just left would hide it among the terms they are not looking for at all.","  */"," export function OnlineWorkshopRoomTermPicker({","     terms,"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

isInteractionBanned: participant.isInteractionBanned,\n        isModerator: participant.isModerator,\n    };\n}\n\n/**\n * Loads the people who wrote the given comments, so every message says whether A room\n *       which lasts for days is measured more coarsely, so that the answer stays small however long it has been open.\n */\nfunction getWorkshopAdminTimelineBucketDurationSeconds(workshopRow: WorkshopRow): number {\n    const startsAtMilliseconds = Date.parse(workshopRow.starts_at);\n    const currentMilliseconds = Date.now();\n    const configuredEndsAtMilliseconds =\n        workshopRow.ends_at === null ? currentMilliseconds : Date.parse(workshopRow.ends_at);\n    const endsAtMilliseconds = Math.max(startsAtMilliseconds, configuredEndsAtMilliseconds);\n    const durationMilliseconds = endsAtMilliseconds - startsAtMilliseconds;\n\n    if (durationMilliseconds <= 2 * 60 * 60 * 1_000) {\n        return 60;\n    }\n\n    if (durationMilliseconds <= 8 * 60 * 60 * 1_000) {\n        return 300;\n    }\n\n    if (durationMilliseconds <= 3 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1_000) {\n        return 900;\n    }\n\n    if (durationMilliseconds <= 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1_000) {\n        return 3_600;\n    }\n\n    return 86_400;\n}\n\nfunction getWorkshopAdminTimelineEndsAt(workshopRow: WorkshopRow): string {\n    const startsAtMilliseconds = Date.parse(workshopRow.starts_at);\n    const endsAtMilliseconds = workshopRow.ends_at === null ? []) as WorkshopSummaryRow[];\n}\n\n/**\n * Resolves legacy public URLs which did not name an occurrence to the term of that very event with the newest start\n * date, so a link of one event never opens a term of another one.\n */\nexport async function findMostRecentPublishedWorkshop(\n    supabase: SupabaseClient,\n    eventType: EventType,\n): Promise<WorkshopRow | null> {\n    const { data, error } = await loadWorkshopQueryWithActiveStatus(supabase, (isActiveStatusFilterEnabled) => {\n            let workshopQuery = supabase\n                .from(WORKSHOP_TABLE_NAME)\n                .select('*')\n                .eq('room_kind', 'workshop')\n                .eq('event_type', eventType)\n                .eq('is_published', true)\n                .order('starts_at', { ascending: false })\n                .limit(1);\n\n            if (isActiveStatusFilterEnabled) {\n                workshopQuery = workshopQuery.eq(WORKSHOP_IS_DELETED_COLUMN_NAME, false);\n            }\n\n            return workshopQuery.maybeSingle();\n    });\n\n    if (error) {\n        console.error('Failed to load the most recent workshop:', error.message);\n        return null;\n    }\n\n    return data as WorkshopRow | null;\n}\n\n/**\n * Lists every published term for the persistent community room, or every published term of one kind of event when a\n * kind is named. loadWorkshopPollAttachedWorkshops(\n    supabase: SupabaseClient,\n    pollIds: readonly string[],\n    isPublishedOnly: boolean,\n): Promise<{\n    readonly attachedWorkshopsByPollId: .from(WORKSHOP_POLL_WORKSHOP_TABLE_NAME)\n        .select('poll_id, workshop_id')\n        .in('poll_id', pollIds);\n    if (attachmentError) {\n        return { attachedWorkshopsByPollId: null, errorMessage: attachmentError.message };\n    }\n\n    const attachmentRows = (attachmentData ?? []) as readonly WorkshopPollWorkshopRow[];\n    if (attachmentRows.length === 0) {\n        return { attachedWorkshopsByPollId: new Map(), errorMessage: null };\n    }\n\n    const { data: workshopData, error: workshopError } = await loadWorkshopQueryWithActiveStatus(\n        supabase,\n        (isActiveStatusFilterEnabled) => {\n            let workshopQuery = supabase\n                .from(WORKSHOP_TABLE_NAME)\n                .select(WORKSHOP_SUMMARY_COLUMNS)\n                .in('id', Array.from(new Set(attachmentRows.map((attachment) => attachment.workshop_id))))\n                .order('starts_at', { ascending: true });\n            if (isPublishedOnly) {\n                workshopQuery = workshopQuery.eq('is_published', true);\n            }\n            if (isActiveStatusFilterEnabled) {\n                workshopQuery = workshopQuery.eq(WORKSHOP_IS_DELETED_COLUMN_NAME, false);\n            }\n\n            return workshopQuery;\n        },\n    );\n    if (workshopError) {\n        return { attachedWorkshopsByPollId: null, errorMessage: workshopError.message };\n    }\n\n    const workshopById = new Map<string, WorkshopSummary>(\n        ((workshopData ?? []) as readonly WorkshopSummaryRow[]).map((workshopSummaryRow) => [\n            workshopSummaryRow.id,\n            mapWorkshopSummaryRow(workshopSummaryRow),\n        ]),\n    );\n    const attachedWorkshopsByPollId = new Map<string, WorkshopSummary[]>();\n    for (const attachment of attachmentRows) {\n        const attachedWorkshop = workshopById.get(attachment.workshop_id);\n        if (attachedWorkshop === undefined) {\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        const attachedWorkshops = attachedWorkshopsByPollId.get(attachment.poll_id) ?? [];\n        attachedWorkshops.push(attachedWorkshop);\n        attachedWorkshopsByPollId.set(attachment.poll_id, attachedWorkshops);\n    }\n\n    attachedWorkshopsByPollId.forEach((attachedWorkshops) =>\n        attachedWorkshops.sort((firstWorkshop, secondWorkshop) =>\n            firstWorkshop.startsAt.localeCompare(secondWorkshop.startsAt),\n        ),\n    );\n\n    return { attachedWorkshopsByPollId, errorMessage: null };\n}\n\n/**\n * The polls asked about one occurrence, which is the opposite direction of the attachment the community writes.\n */\nasync function loadWorkshopAttachedPollIds(\n    supabase: SupabaseClient,\n    workshopId: string,\n): Promise<{ readonly pollIds: readonly string[] | null; readonly errorMessage: string | null }> {\n    const { data, error } = await supabase\n        .from(WORKSHOP_POLL_WORKSHOP_TABLE_NAME)\n        .select('poll_id')\n        .eq('workshop_id', workshopId);\n    if (error) {\n        return { pollIds: null, errorMessage: error.message };\n    }\n\n    return {\n        pollIds: ((data ?? []) as readonly Pick<WorkshopPollWorkshopRow, 'poll_id'>[]).map(\n            (attachment) => attachment.poll_id,\n        ),\n        errorMessage: null,\n    };\n}\n\nasync function loadWorkshopPollRows(\n    supabase: SupabaseClient,\n    workshopRow: WorkshopRow,\n    voterEmail: string | null,\n    scope: WorkshopPollLoadScope,\n): Promise<{ readonly loadedPollRows: LoadedWorkshopPollRows | null; readonly errorMessage: string | null }> {\n    let pollQuery = supabase.from(WORKSHOP_POLL_TABLE_NAME).select(WORKSHOP_POLL_COLUMNS);\n    if (scope.isAttachedToRoom) {\n        const { pollIds: attachedPollIds, errorMessage } = await loadWorkshopAttachedPollIds(supabase, workshopRow.id);\n        if (attachedPollIds === null) {\n            return { loadedPollRows: null, errorMessage };\n        }\n        if (attachedPollIds.length === 0) {\n            return { loadedPollRows: EMPTY_LOADED_WORKSHOP_POLL_ROWS, errorMessage: null };\n        }\n\n        pollQuery = pollQuery.in('id', attachedPollIds);\n    } else {\n        pollQuery = pollQuery.eq('workshop_id', workshopRow.id);\n    }\n    if (scope.isMemberVisibleOnly) {\n        pollQuery = pollQuery.eq('is_visible', true);\n    }\n\n    const pollQueryWithOrder = scope.isMemberVisibleOnly\n        ? pollQuery.order('is_closed', { ascending: true }).order('created_at', { ascending: false })\n        : pollQuery.order('created_at', { ascending: false });\n    const { data: pollData, error: pollError } = await pollQueryWithOrder.limit(scope.maximalPollCount);\n    if (pollError) {\n        return { loadedPollRows: null, errorMessage: pollError.message };\n    }\n\n    const pollRows = (pollData ?? []) as readonly WorkshopPollRow[];\n    const pollIds = pollRows.map((poll) => poll.id);\n    if (pollIds.length === 0) {\n        return { loadedPollRows: EMPTY_LOADED_WORKSHOP_POLL_ROWS, errorMessage: null };\n    }\n\n    const [optionsResult, voteCountsResult, selectedVotesResult, attachedWorkshopsResult] = await Promise.all([\n        supabase\n            .from(WORKSHOP_POLL_OPTION_TABLE_NAME)\n            .select(WORKSHOP_POLL_OPTION_COLUMNS)\n            .in('poll_id', pollIds)\n            .order('sort_order', { ascending: true }),\n        supabase.rpc('get_workshop_poll_option_vote_counts', { target_poll_ids: pollIds }),\n        voterEmail === null\n            ? Promise.resolve({ data: [] as readonly WorkshopParticipantPollVoteRow[], error: null })\n            : supabase\n                  .from(WORKSHOP_POLL_VOTE_TABLE_NAME)\n                  .select('option_id')\n                  .eq('voter_email', voterEmail)\n                  .in('poll_id', pollIds),\n        loadWorkshopPollAttachedWorkshops(supabase, pollIds, scope.isMemberVisibleOnly),\n    ]);\n    const firstError = optionsResult.error ?? voteCountsResult.error ?? selectedVotesResult.error;\n    if (firstError) {\n        return { loadedPollRows: null, errorMessage: firstError.message };\n    }\n    if (attachedWorkshopsResult.attachedWorkshopsByPollId === null) {\n        return { loadedPollRows: null, errorMessage: attachedWorkshopsResult.errorMessage };\n    }\n\n    const optionRowsByPollId = new Map<string, WorkshopPollOptionRow[]>();\n    for (const optionRow of (optionsResult.data ?? []) as readonly WorkshopPollOptionRow[]) {\n        const optionRows = optionRowsByPollId.get(optionRow.poll_id) ?? [];\n        optionRows.push(optionRow);\n        optionRowsByPollId.set(optionRow.poll_id, optionRows);\n    }\n\n    return {\n        loadedPollRows: {\n            pollRows,\n            optionRowsByPollId,\n            voteCountByOptionId: new Map<string, number>(\n                ((voteCountsResult.data ?? []) as readonly WorkshopPollVoteCountRow[]).map((voteCount) => [\n                    voteCount.option_id,\n                    getNonNegativeWholeNumber(voteCount.vote_count),\n                ]),\n            ),\n            selectedOptionIds: new Set(\n                ((selectedVotesResult.data ?? []) as readonly WorkshopParticipantPollVoteRow[]).map(\n                    (vote) => vote.option_id,\n                ),\n            ),\n            attachedWorkshopsByPollId: attachedWorkshopsResult.attachedWorkshopsByPollId,\n        },\n        errorMessage: null,\n    };\n}\n\nfunction mapLoadedWorkshopPolls<Option extends WorkshopPollOption>(\n    loadedPollRows: LoadedWorkshopPollRows,\n    mapOption: (\n        row: WorkshopPollOptionRow,\n        voteCountByOptionId: ReadonlyMap<string, number>,\n        selectedOptionIds: ReadonlySet<string>,\n    ) => Option,\n): readonly (Omit<WorkshopPoll, 'options'> & { readonly options: readonly Option[] })[] {\n    return loadedPollRows.pollRows.map((pollRow) =>\n        mapWorkshopPollRow(\n            pollRow,\n            (loadedPollRows.optionRowsByPollId.get(pollRow.id) ?? []).map((optionRow) =>\n                mapOption(optionRow, loadedPollRows.voteCountByOptionId, loadedPollRows.selectedOptionIds),\n            ),\n            loadedPollRows.attachedWorkshopsByPollId.get(pollRow.id) ?? [],\n        ),\n    );\n}\n\n/**\n * Loads the compact, anonymous result of visible community polls. The count aggregation stays in PostgreSQL and the\n * participant-specific lookup contains only that participant's own selection, so no room response can infer who\n * anybody else voted for. One normalized e-mail identity has the same selection in the community and in every\n * attached workshop, while the poll itself remains owned and administered by the community.\n */\nexport async function loadWorkshopPolls(\n    supabase: SupabaseClient,\n    workshopRow: WorkshopRow,\n    voterEmail: string | null,\n): Promise<LoadedWorkshopPolls> {\n    if (!isWorkshopPollVisibleInRoom(workshopRow.room_kind)) {\n        return { polls: [], errorMessage: null };\n    }\n\n    const isAttachedToRoom = getWorkshopKindCapabilities(workshopRow.room_kind).isAttachedCommunityPollsShown;\n    const normalizedVoterEmail = voterEmail === null ? null : normalizeWorkshopParticipantEmail(voterEmail);\n\n    const { loadedPollRows, errorMessage } = await loadWorkshopPollRows(supabase, workshopRow, normalizedVoterEmail, {\n        isMemberVisibleOnly: true,\n        isAttachedToRoom,\n        maximalPollCount: MAXIMAL_VISIBLE_WORKSHOP_POLL_COUNT,\n    });\n    if (loadedPollRows === null) {\n        return { polls: [], errorMessage };\n    }\n\n    return {\n        polls: mapLoadedWorkshopPolls(loadedPollRows, mapWorkshopPollOptionRow),\n        errorMessage: null,\n    };\n}\n\n/**\n * The same aggregate loader powers the administration, but it deliberately includes hidden polls and returns the\n * artificial component only to the signed-in dashboard.\n */\nexport async function loadWorkshopAdminPolls(\n    supabase: SupabaseClient,\n    workshopRow: WorkshopRow,\n): Promise<LoadedWorkshopPolls<WorkshopAdminPoll>> {\n    if (!getWorkshopKindCapabilities(workshopRow.room_kind).isPollsOffered) {\n        return { polls: [], errorMessage: null };\n maximalPollCount: MAXIMAL_ADMIN_WORKSHOP_POLL_COUNT,\n    });\n    if (loadedPollRows === null) {\n        return { polls: [], errorMessage };\n    }\n\n    return {\n        polls: mapLoadedWorkshopPolls(loadedPollRows, mapWorkshopAdminPollOptionRow),\n        errorMessage: null,\n    };\n}\n\n/**\n * The community polls asked about one workshop occurrence, read for the */\nexport async function loadWorkshopAttachedAdminPolls(\n    supabase: SupabaseClient,\n    workshopRow: WorkshopRow,\n): Promise<LoadedWorkshopPolls<WorkshopAdminPoll>> {\n    if (!getWorkshopKindCapabilities(workshopRow.room_kind).isAttachedCommunityPollsShown) {\n        return { polls: [], errorMessage: null };\n    }\n\n    const { loadedPollRows, errorMessage } = await loadWorkshopPollRows(supabase, workshopRow, null, {\n        isMemberVisibleOnly: false,\n        isAttachedToRoom: true,\n        maximalPollCount: MAXIMAL_ADMIN_WORKSHOP_POLL_COUNT,\n    });\n    if (loadedPollRows === null) {\n        return { polls: [], errorMessage };\n    }\n\n    return {\n        polls: mapLoadedWorkshopPolls(loadedPollRows, mapWorkshopAdminPollOptionRow),\n        errorMessage: null,\n    };\n}\n\n/**\n * Loads one page of participants together with the activity totals used for its sortable columns.\n *\n * Note: The database applies the filters and sort before it limits the result, so a large workshop never needs to send\n * every participant to the browser just to display one page.\n */\nexport async function loadWorkshopAdminParticipantPage(\n    supabase: SupabaseClient,\n    workshopId: string,\n    query: WorkshopAdminParticipantQuery,\n): Promise<{ readonly page: WorkshopAdminParticipantPage | null; readonly errorMessage: string | null }> {\n    const participantPageParameters = {\n        target_workshop_id: workshopId,\n        target_search_query: query.searchQuery,\n        target_is_trusted: query.isTrusted,\n        target_is_moderator: query.isModerator,\n        target_is_interaction_banned: query.isInteractionBanned,\n        target_registered_from: query.registeredFrom,\n        target_registered_to: query.registeredTo,\n        target_sort_by: query.sortBy,\n        target_sort_direction: query.sortDirection,\n        target_limit: query.pageSize,\n        target_offset: (query.page - 1) * query.pageSize,\n    };\n    const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc(\n        WORKSHOP_ADMIN_PARTICIPANT_PAGE_FUNCTION_NAME,\n        participantPageParameters,\n    );\n    if (error) {\n        return {\n            page: null,\n            errorMessage: reportSupabaseError(\n                `\\`${WORKSHOP_ADMIN_PARTICIPANT_PAGE_FUNCTION_NAME}\\``,\n                error,\n []) as WorkshopAdminParticipantPageRow[];\n    return {\n        page: {\n            participants: participantRows.map(mapWorkshopAdminParticipantPageRow),\n            totalCount: getNonNegativeWholeNumber(participantRows[0]?.total_count),\n        },\n        errorMessage: null,\n    };\n}\n\n/**\n * Loads the exact actions of one participant from their existing source records.\n *\n * Note: Registration and last activity are participant fields rather than action rows, so they are added as two\n * explicit timeline events next to comments, reactions, and votes. loadWorkshopAdminParticipantTimeline(\n    supabase: SupabaseClient,\n    workshopRow: WorkshopRow,\n    participantId: string,\n): Promise<{ readonly timeline: WorkshopAdminParticipantTimeline | null; readonly errorMessage: string | null }> {\n    const [participantResult, commentsResult, reactionsResult, upvotesResult] = await Promise.all([\n        supabase\n true })\n                .order('id', { ascending: true })\n                .range(fromIndex, toIndex),\n        ),\n        loadAllSupabaseRows<WorkshopReactionRow>((fromIndex, toIndex) =>\n .eq('participant_id', participantId)\n                .order('created_at', { ascending: true })\n                .order('id', { ascending: true })\n                .range(fromIndex, toIndex),\n        ),\n        loadAllSupabaseRows<WorkshopCommentUpvoteRow>((fromIndex, toIndex) =>\n            supabase\n                .from(WORKSHOP_UPVOTE_TABLE_NAME)\n                .select('id, comment_id, created_at')\n                .eq('workshop_id', workshopRow.id)\n                .eq('participant_id', participantId)\n                .order('created_at', { ascending: true })\n errorMessage: firstErrorMessage };\n    }\n\n    if (participantResult.data === null) {\n        return { timeline: null, errorMessage: null };\n    }\n\n    const participant = participantResult.data as WorkshopAdminParticipantRow;\n    const commentRows = commentsResult.rows ?? []).map((comment) => [comment.id, comment] as const),\n    );\n    const events: WorkshopParticipantTimelineEvent[] = [\n        { kind: 'joined' as const, id: `joined-${participant.id}`, occurredAt: participant.connected_at },\n        { kind: 'last-seen' as const, id: `last-seen-${participant.id}`, occurredAt: participant.last_seen_at },\n        ...commentRows.map((comment): WorkshopParticipantTimelineEvent => ({\n            kind: 'comment',\n            id: comment.id,\n            occurredAt: comment.created_at,\n            body: comment.body,\n            status: comment.status,\n        })),\n        ...reactionRows.map((reaction): WorkshopParticipantTimelineEvent => ({\n            kind: 'reaction',\n            id: reaction.id,\n            occurredAt: reaction.created_at,\n            emoji: reaction.emoji,\n        })),\n        ...upvoteRows.map((upvote): WorkshopParticipantTimelineEvent => {\n            const comment = upvotedCommentById.get(upvote.comment_id);\n            return {\n                kind: 'upvote',\n                id: upvote.id,\n                occurredAt: upvote.created_at,\n                commentId: upvote.comment_id,\n                commentAuthorName: comment?.author_name ?? null,\n                commentBody: comment?.body ?? null,\n            };\n        }),\n    ].sort(\n        (firstEvent, secondEvent) =>\n            firstEvent.occurredAt.localeCompare(secondEvent.occurredAt) || firstEvent.id.localeCompare(secondEvent.id),\n    );\n\n    return {\n        timeline: {\n            participant: mapWorkshopAdminParticipantRow(participant, {\n                participant_id: participant.id,\n                comment_count: commentRows.length,\n                reaction_count: reactionRows.length,\n                upvote_count: upvoteRows.length,\n            }),\n            events,\n        },\n        errorMessage: null,\n    };\n}\n\n/**\n * Loads the newest messages of a room with nothing but the moment they were written\n *\n * Note: The administration counts the matches of a regular expression in the browser, so a metric which is still being\n *       typed answers at once. A very busy room is sampled from its newest messages, because those are the ones a\n *       graph of it is read for.\n */\nasync function loadWorkshopAdminCommentSamples(\n    supabase: SupabaseClient,\n    workshopRow: WorkshopRow,\n): Promise<{\n    readonly commentSamples: readonly WorkshopAdminCommentSample[] | null;\n    readonly isCommentSampleComplete: boolean;\n    readonly errorMessage: string | null;\n}> {\n    const { data, error } = await supabase\n        .from(WORKSHOP_COMMENT_TABLE_NAME)\n        .select('body, created_at')\n        .eq('workshop_id', workshopRow.id)\n        .order('created_at', { ascending: false })\n        .limit(MAXIMAL_WORKSHOP_ADMIN_COMMENT_SAMPLE_COUNT + 1);\n\n    if (error) {\n        return { commentSamples: null, isCommentSampleComplete: false, errorMessage: error.message };\n    }\n\n    const rows = (data ?? []) as WorkshopAdminCommentSampleRow[];\n    const isCommentSampleComplete = rows.length <= MAXIMAL_WORKSHOP_ADMIN_COMMENT_SAMPLE_COUNT;\n\n    return {\n        commentSamples: rows\n            .slice(0, MAXIMAL_WORKSHOP_ADMIN_COMMENT_SAMPLE_COUNT)\n            .map((row) => ({ occurredAt: row.created_at, body: row.body }))\n            .reverse(),\n        isCommentSampleComplete,\n        errorMessage: null,\n    };\n}\n\n/**\n * Loads compact workshop-wide timeline buckets and reaction totals for the overview and reactions sections.\n */\nexport async function loadWorkshopAdminAnalytics(\n    supabase: SupabaseClient,\n    workshopRow: WorkshopRow,\n): Promise<{ readonly analytics: WorkshopAdminAnalytics | null; readonly errorMessage: string | null }> {\n    const bucketDurationSeconds = getWorkshopAdminTimelineBucketDurationSeconds(workshopRow);\n    const timelineArguments = {\n        target_workshop_id: workshopRow.id,\n        target_bucket_seconds: bucketDurationSeconds,\n    };\n    const [timelineResult, reactionTimelineResult, reactionCountsResult, commentSampleResult] = await Promise.all([\n        supabase.rpc('get_workshop_admin_timeline', timelineArguments),\n        supabase.rpc('get_workshop_admin_reaction_timeline', timelineArguments),\n        supabase.rpc('get_workshop_reaction_counts', { target_workshop_id: workshopRow.id }),\n        loadWorkshopAdminCommentSamples(supabase, workshopRow),\n    ]);\n    const firstError =\n        timelineResult.error ??\n        reactionTimelineResult.error ??\n        reactionCountsResult.error ??\n        (commentSampleResult.errorMessage === null ? null : { message: commentSampleResult.errorMessage });\n    if (firstError) {\n        return { analytics: null, errorMessage: firstError.message };\n    }\n\n    const reactionCountsByBucket = groupWorkshopAdminReactionTimelineRows(\n        (reactionTimelineResult.data ?? []) as WorkshopAdminTimelinePointRow[]).map((row) =>\n                mapWorkshopAdminTimelinePointRow(row, reactionCountsByBucket.get(row.bucket_starts_at) ?? {}),\n            ),\n            reactionCounts: ((reactionCountsResult.data ?? [],\n            isCommentSampleComplete: commentSampleResult.isCommentSampleComplete,\n        },\n        errorMessage: null,\n    };\n}\n\n/**\n * Loads every participant which matches the [] : [futureFollowUpContentResult.data as WorkshopContentRow]),\n    ]\n        .sort(\n            (firstContentBlock, secondContentBlock) =>\n                firstContentBlock.sort_order - this member may read is prepared for them; a withheld material never has its links materialized,\n    // because nothing of it but its title is going to leave the server.\n    const { (materializedContentResult) => materializedContentResult.errorMessage !== null,\n    )?.errorMessage;\n    if (materializationErrorMessage !== null && materializationErrorMessage !== undefined) {\n        return { state: null, errorMessage: materializationErrorMessage };\n    }\n    const materializedContentBlocks = materializedContentResults.map((materializedContentResult) => ({\n        ...materializedContentResult.contentBlock,\n        bodyMarkdown: materializedContentResult.bodyMarkdown ?? materializedContentResult.contentBlock.bodyMarkdown,\n    }));\n\n    const commentRows = {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01LSnRpBCZAKaBeUhSadCzrx","type":"tool_result","content":"The file C:\\Users\\me\\work\\promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages\\aldaron\\app\\api\\workshops\\[workshopSlug]\\feedback\\route.ts has been updated successfully. (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"c52b48c2-bdba-425b-985d-7f91042b4a9e","uuid":"614c2528-3f37-4fd7-9a53-5cbb12b2946b","timestamp":"2026-09-16T11:43:32.248Z","tool_use_result":{"filePath":"C:\\Users\\me\\work\\promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages\\aldaron\\app\\api\\workshops\\[workshopSlug]\\feedback\\route.ts","oldString":"        authenticatedRequest.workshopRow.room_kind !== 'workshop' ||\n        getWorkshopPhase(mapWorkshopRow(authenticatedRequest.workshopRow)) !== 'past'","newString":"        authenticatedRequest.workshopRow.room_kind !== 'workshop' ||\n        !isWorkshopPhasePast(getWorkshopPhase(mapWorkshopRow(authenticatedRequest.workshopRow)))","originalFile":"import { getCrossSiteResponseOrNull } from '@/lib/api/getCrossSiteResponseOrNull';\nimport { readJsonObjectOrNull } from '@/lib/api/readJsonObjectOrNull';\nimport { WORKSHOP_FEEDBACK_TABLE_NAME } from '@/lib/workshops/workshopConstants';\nimport { mapWorkshopFeedbackRow, mapWorkshopRow, type WorkshopFeedbackRow } from '@/lib/workshops/workshopDatabase';\nimport { getWorkshopPhase, isWorkshopPhasePast } from '@/lib/workshops/workshopPhase';\nimport { getAuthenticatedWorkshopRequest, isAuthenticatedWorkshopRequest } from '@/lib/workshops/workshopRequest';\nimport { workshopFeedbackUpdateSchema } from '@/lib/workshops/workshopSchemas';\nimport { createWorkshopFeedbackUpdateDatabaseValues } from '@/lib/workshops/workshopValues';\nimport { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';\n\ntype WorkshopFeedbackRouteContext = {\n    readonly params: Promise<{ readonly workshopSlug: string }>;\n};\n\n/**\n * Persists one step of the participant's post-workshop feedback.\n *\n * A score initializes the one row for a participant. The optional text fields deliberately update that row afterwards,\n * allowing each answer to survive independently if the participant does not continue through the whole form.\n */\nexport async function PATCH(request: NextRequest, context: WorkshopFeedbackRouteContext) {\n    const crossSiteResponse = getCrossSiteResponseOrNull(request);\n    if (crossSiteResponse) {\n        return crossSiteResponse;\n    }\n\n    const body = await readJsonObjectOrNull(request);\n    const parsedResult = workshopFeedbackUpdateSchema.safeParse(body);\n    if (!parsedResult.success) {\n        return NextResponse.json(\n            { error: parsedResult.error.issues[0]?.message ?? 'Feedback is not valid' },\n            { status: 400 },\n        );\n    }\n\n    const { workshopSlug } = await context.params;\n    const authenticatedRequest = await getAuthenticatedWorkshopRequest(request, workshopSlug);\n    if (!isAuthenticatedWorkshopRequest(authenticatedRequest)) {\n        return authenticatedRequest;\n    }\n\n    if (\n        authenticatedRequest.workshopRow.room_kind !== 'workshop' ||\n        getWorkshopPhase(mapWorkshopRow(authenticatedRequest.workshopRow)) !== 'past'\n    ) {\n        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Feedback is available after the workshop ends' }, { status: 403 });\n    }\n\n    const values = createWorkshopFeedbackUpdateDatabaseValues(parsedResult.data);\n    const feedbackQuery =\n        parsedResult.data.rating === undefined\n            ? authenticatedRequest.supabase\n                  .from(WORKSHOP_FEEDBACK_TABLE_NAME)\n                  .update(values)\n                  .eq('workshop_id', authenticatedRequest.workshopRow.id)\n                  .eq('participant_id', authenticatedRequest.participant.id)\n            : authenticatedRequest.supabase\n                  .from(WORKSHOP_FEEDBACK_TABLE_NAME)\n                  .upsert(\n                      {\n                          workshop_id: authenticatedRequest.workshopRow.id,\n                          participant_id: authenticatedRequest.participant.id,\n                          ...values,\n                      },\n                      { onConflict: 'workshop_id,participant_id' },\n                  );\n    const { data, error } = await feedbackQuery.select('id, workshop_id, participant_id, rating, what_was_good, what_was_bad, note, created_at, updated_at').maybeSingle();\n    if (error) {\n        console.error('Failed to save workshop feedback:', error.message);\n        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Feedback could not be saved' }, { status: 500 });\n    }\n    if (data === null) {\n        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Please choose a rating before answering the questions' }, { status: 409 });\n    }\n\n    return NextResponse.json({ feedback: mapWorkshopFeedbackRow(data as WorkshopFeedbackRow) });\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":41,"oldLines":7,"newStart":41,"newLines":7,"lines":[" ","     if (","         authenticatedRequest.workshopRow.room_kind !== 'workshop' ||","-        getWorkshopPhase(mapWorkshopRow(authenticatedRequest.workshopRow)) !== 'past'","+        !isWorkshopPhasePast(getWorkshopPhase(mapWorkshopRow(authenticatedRequest.workshopRow)))","     ) {","         return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Feedback is available after the workshop ends' }, { status: 403 });","     }"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

{workshops.map((workshop) => (\n                <li key={workshop.id} className=\"min-w-0\">\n                    <WorkshopSelectorCard\n                        workshop={workshop}\n                        isSelected={workshop.id === selectedWorkshopId}\n                        onSelect={onSelect}\n                    />\n                </li>\n            ))}\n        </ul>\n    );\n}\n\n/**\n * id={`${pastWorkshopsListId}-current`}\n                                        className=\"px-1 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500\"\n                                    >\n                workshops={currentAndUpcomingWorkshops}\n                                            selectedWorkshopId={selectedWorkshopId}\n readonly WorkshopAdminSummary[];\n    readonly selectedWorkshopId: string | null;\n    readonly isLoading: boolean;\n    readonly emptyMessage: string;\n    readonly onSelect: (workshopId: string) => lg:max-h-[min(34rem,calc(100dvh-31rem))] lg:overflow-y-auto lg:pr-1';\n\nfunction normalizeWorkshopSearchQuery(searchQuery: string): string {\n    return searchQuery\n        .trim()\n        .toLocaleLowerCase(CZECH_LOCALE)\n        .normalize('NFD')\n        .replace(/[\\u0300-\\u036f]/g, '');\n}\n\nfunction isWorkshopMatchingSearchQuery(workshop: WorkshopAdminSummary, normalizedSearchQuery: string): boolean {\n    if (normalizedSearchQuery.length === 0) {\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    return normalizeWorkshopSearchQuery(`${workshop.title} ${workshop.slug}`).includes(normalizedSearchQuery);\n}\n\ntype WorkshopSelectorCardGridProps = {\n    readonly accessibleLabel: string;\n    readonly workshops: readonly WorkshopAdminSummary[];\n    readonly selectedWorkshopId: string | null;\n    readonly onSelect: (workshopId: string) => void;\n};\n\n/**\n * Renders each selectable workshop in one place, so the current terms and the progressively disclosed archive stay\n * equally informative and behave identically.\n */\nfunction WorkshopSelectorCardGrid({\n    accessibleLabel,\n    workshops,\n    selectedWorkshopId,\n    onSelect,\n}: WorkshopSelectorCardGridProps) {\n    return (\n        <ul aria-label={accessibleLabel} className={WORKSHOP_CARD_GRID_CLASS_NAME}>\n            {workshops.map((workshop) => (\n                <li key={workshop.id} className=\"min-w-0\">\n                    <WorkshopSelectorCard\n                        workshop={workshop}\n                        isSelected={workshop.id === selectedWorkshopId}\n                        onSelect={onSelect}\n                    />\n                </li>\n            ))}\n        </ul>\n    );\n}\n\n/**\n * Offers every occurrence as a card, ordered so that a running room leads the list, the prepared terms follow it, and\n * the history closes it.\n */\nexport function WorkshopSelectorCardList({\n    label,\n    workshops,\n    selectedWorkshopId,\n    isLoading,\n    emptyMessage,\n    onSelect,\n}: WorkshopSelectorCardListProps) {\n    const searchInputId = useId();\n    const pastWorkshopsListId = useId();\n    const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');\n    const [isPastWorkshopsExpanded, setIsPastWorkshopsExpanded] = useState(false);\n    const normalizedSearchQuery = useMemo(() => normalizeWorkshopSearchQuery(searchQuery), [searchQuery]);\n    const matchingWorkshops = useMemo(() => {\n        return workshops.filter((workshop) => isWorkshopMatchingSearchQuery(workshop, normalizedSearchQuery));\n    }, [normalizedSearchQuery, workshops]);\n    const matchingWorkshopsByPhase = useMemo(() => groupWorkshopsByPhase(matchingWorkshops), [matchingWorkshops]);\n    const currentAndUpcomingWorkshops = [\n        ...matchingWorkshopsByPhase.ongoing,\n        ...matchingWorkshopsByPhase.upcoming,\n    ];\n\n    // Note: An administrator works on a term which has only just been held exactly as they work on any other finished\n    //       one, so the history holds both of them. It merely leads that history, because the workshop of last night\n    //       is the one still being wrapped up.\n    const pastWorkshops = [...matchingWorkshopsByPhase['freshly-past'], ...matchingWorkshopsByPhase.past];\n    const selectedWorkshop = workshops.find((workshop) => workshop.id === selectedWorkshopId);\n    const isSelectedWorkshopPast =\n        selectedWorkshop !== undefined && isWorkshopPhasePast(getWorkshopPhase(selectedWorkshop));\n    const isSearchQueryPresent = normalizedSearchQuery.length > 0;\n    const isPastWorkshopsVisible = isPastWorkshopsExpanded || isSelectedWorkshopPast || isSearchQueryPresent;\n\n    return (\n        <section className=\"rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm\">\n            <h2 className=\"text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500\">{label}</h2>\n            {isLoading ? (\n                <div className=\"flex justify-center py-6\">\n                    <RefreshCw className=\"h-4 w-4 animate-spin text-cyan-600\" aria-label=\"Načítání\" />\n                </div>\n            ) : workshops.length === 0 ? (\n                <p className=\"mt-3 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 px-3 py-4 text-sm text-slate-500\">\n                    {emptyMessage}\n                </p>\n            ) : (\n                <>\n                    <label htmlFor={searchInputId} className=\"sr-only\">\n                        Hledat workshop\n                    </label>\n                    <div className=\"relative mt-3\">\n                        <Search\n                            className=\"pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400\"\n                            aria-hidden=\"true\"\n                        />\n                        <Input\n                            id={searchInputId}\n                            type=\"search\"\n                            value={searchQuery}\n                            onChange={(event) => setSearchQuery(event.target.value)}\n                            placeholder=\"Hledat workshop\"\n                            className=\"h-9 pl-9\"\n                        />\n                    </div>\n                    {matchingWorkshops.length === 0 ? (\n                        <p className=\"mt-3 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 px-3 py-4 text-sm text-slate-500\">\n                            Žádný workshop neodpovídá hledání.\n                        </p>\n                    ) : (\n                        <div className={WORKSHOP_LIST_CLASS_NAME}>\n                            {currentAndUpcomingWorkshops.length > 0 && (\n                                <section aria-labelledby={`${pastWorkshopsListId}-current`}>\n                                    <h3\n                                        id={`${pastWorkshopsListId}-current`}\n                                        className=\"px-1 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500\"\n                                    >\n                                        Aktuální a nadcházející ({currentAndUpcomingWorkshops.length})\n                                    </h3>\n                                    <div className=\"mt-1.5\">\n                                        <WorkshopSelectorCardGrid\n                                            accessibleLabel=\"Seznam workshopů\"\n                                            workshops={currentAndUpcomingWorkshops}\n                                            selectedWorkshopId={selectedWorkshopId}\n                                            onSelect={onSelect}\n                                        />\n                                    </div>\n                                </section>\n                            )}\n\n                            {matchingWorkshopsByPhase.past.length > 0 && (\n                                <section>\n                                    <button\n                                        type=\"button\"\n                                        aria-controls={pastWorkshopsListId}\n                                        aria-expanded={isPastWorkshopsVisible}\n                                        onClick={() => setIsPastWorkshopsExpanded((isExpanded) => !isExpanded)}\n                                        className=\"flex w-full items-center justify-between rounded-lg px-1 py-1 text-left text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 transition-colors hover:text-slate-800\"\n                                    >\n                                        Historie ({matchingWorkshopsByPhase.past.length})\n                                        <ChevronDown\n                                            className={`h-4 w-4 shrink-0 transition-transform ${isPastWorkshopsVisible ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`}\n                                            aria-hidden=\"true\"\n                                        />\n                                    </button>\n                                    {isPastWorkshopsVisible && (\n                                        <div className=\"mt-1.5\" id={pastWorkshopsListId}>\n                                            <WorkshopSelectorCardGrid\n                                                accessibleLabel=\"Historie workshopů\"\n                                                workshops={matchingWorkshopsByPhase.past}\n                                                selectedWorkshopId={selectedWorkshopId}\n                                                onSelect={onSelect}\n                                            />\n                                        </div>\n                                    )}\n                                </section>\n                            )}\n                        </div>\n                    )}\n                </>\n            )}\n        </section>\n    );\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":2,"oldLines":7,"newStart":2,"newLines":7,"lines":[" "," import { WorkshopSelectorCard } from '@/businesses/workshop-admin/WorkshopSelectorCard';"," import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';","-import { getWorkshopPhase, groupWorkshopsByPhase } from '@/lib/workshops/workshopPhase';","+import { getWorkshopPhase, groupWorkshopsByPhase, isWorkshopPhasePast } from '@/lib/workshops/workshopPhase';"," import type { WorkshopAdminSummary } from '@/lib/workshops/workshopTypes';"," import { ChevronDown, RefreshCw, Search } from 'lucide-react';"," import { useId, useMemo, useState } from 'react';"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

                    </p>\n                    ) : (\n                        <div className={WORKSHOP_LIST_CLASS_NAME}>\n                            {currentAndUpcomingWorkshops.length > 0 && (\n id={`${pastWorkshopsListId}-current`}\n                                        className=\"px-1 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500\"\n                                    >\n type=\"button\"\n                                        aria-controls={pastWorkshopsListId}\n                                        aria-expanded={isPastWorkshopsVisible}\n id={`${pastWorkshopsListId}-current`}\n                                        className=\"px-1 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500\"\n                                    >\n currentTimeMilliseconds,\n    timeZone,\n}: EventListingOptions): readonly EventListing[] {\n    return sortWorkshopsByPhase(workshops, currentTimeMilliseconds).flatMap((workshop) => {\n        const = {\n    ...ONGOING_WORKSHOP,\n    id: 'upcoming-workshop-id',\n    slug: 'ai-supervize-mini-2026-09-24',\n    title: 'AI Supervize Mini',\n    event: {\n        ...DEFAULT_EVENT_DETAILS,\n        type: 'ai-supervize-mini',\n        locationKind: 'onsite',\n        locationLabel: 'Praha',\n        priceCzk: 12000,\n    },\n    startsAt: '2026-09-24T10:00:00+02:00',\n    endsAt: '2026-09-12T20:30:00+02:00',\n};\n\nconst PAST_WORKSHOP: WorkshopSummary = {\n    ...ONGOING_WORKSHOP,\n    id: 'past-workshop-id',\n    slug: 'production-ai-2026-07-10',\n    title: 'Produkční kód s AI agenty v červenci',\n    startsAt: '2026-07-10T19:00:00+02:00',\n    endsAt: '2026-07-10T20:30:00+02:00',\n};\n\nconst EXTERNAL_CONFERENCE_URL = 'https://konference.example.com/program';\n\nconst readonly WorkshopSummary[] = [PAST_WORKSHOP, ONGOING_WORKSHOP, UPCOMING_WORKSHOP];\n\nfunction renderWorkshopLinksPanel(workshops: readonly WorkshopSummary[] = WORKSHOPS) {\n    render(\n        <WorkshopLinksPanel\n            workshops={workshops}\n            participantIdentity={PARTICIPANT_IDENTITY}\n            title=\"Termíny akcí Promptbooku\"\n            description=\"Vyberte si calendarFeedUrl={CALENDAR_FEED_URL}\n        />,\n    );\n}\n\nfunction findCalendarDay(dayKey: string): HTMLElement {\n    return screen.getByRole('button', { name: formatCalendarDayTitle(dayKey, {\n    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Karty' }));\n}\n\nafterEach(cleanup);\n\ndescribe('workshop links panel', () => {\n    it('opens on the calendar of the month a member is in', () => {\n        renderWorkshopLinksPanel();\n\n        expect(screen.getAllByText('září 2026').length).toBeGreaterThan(0);\n        expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: /Produkční kód s AI agenty/ })).not.toBeNull();\n        expect(screen.queryByRole('link', { name: /v červenci/ })).toBeNull();\n    });\n\n    it('colours every day of the calendar by where the term held on it stands in time', () => {\n        renderWorkshopLinksPanel();\n\n        expect(findCalendarDay('2026-09-10').className).toContain(\n            getWorkshopPhaseAppearance('ongoing').calendarDayClassName,\n        );\n        expect(findCalendarDay('2026-09-24').className).toContain(\n            getWorkshopPhaseAppearance('upcoming').calendarDayClassName,\n        );\n        expect(findCalendarDay('2026-09-11').getAttribute('disabled')).not.toBeNull();\n    });\n\n    it('narrows the listed terms to the chosen day and back to the whole month', () => {\n        renderWorkshopLinksPanel();\n\n        fireEvent.click(findCalendarDay('2026-09-24'));\n\n        expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: /AI Supervize Mini/ })).not.toBeNull();\n        expect(screen.queryByRole('link', { name: /Produkční kód s AI agenty/ })).toBeNull();\n\n        fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Celý měsíc' }));\n\n        expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: /Produkční kód s AI agenty/ })).not.toBeNull();\n    });\n\n    it('lists every term of every month once the cards are chosen', () => {\n        renderWorkshopLinksPanel();\n        showCardsView();\n\n        expect(findTermLinks().map((termLink) => termLink.textContent)).toEqual([\n            expect.stringContaining(ONGOING_WORKSHOP.title),\n            expect.stringContaining(UPCOMING_WORKSHOP.title),\n            expect.stringContaining(PAST_WORKSHOP.title),\n        ]);\n    });\n\n    it('names a term held today, tomorrow, or later this week rather than only dating it', () => {\n        renderWorkshopLinksPanel([ONGOING_WORKSHOP, TOMORROW_WORKSHOP, THIS_WEEK_WORKSHOP, UPCOMING_WORKSHOP]);\n        showCardsView();\n\n        expect(findTermLinks().map((termLink) => termLink.textContent)).toEqual([\n            expect.stringContaining('dnes, čtvrtek 10. 9. 2026'),\n            expect.stringContaining('zítra, pátek 11. 9. 2026'),\n            expect.stringContaining('tato sobota 12. 9. 2026'),\n            expect.stringContaining('čtvrtek 24. 9. 2026'),\n        ]);\n    });\n\n    it('says on every card whether its term is running, still ahead, or already over', () => {\n        renderWorkshopLinksPanel();\n        showCardsView();\n\n        const [ongoingCard, upcomingCard, pastCard] = findTermLinks();\n\n        expect(ongoingCard?.textContent).toContain('Probíhá');\n        expect(upcomingCard?.textContent).toContain('Nadchází');\n        expect(pastCard?.textContent).toContain('Proběhlo');\n    });\n\n    it('links a community member to every workshop room with their identity prefilled', () => {\n        renderWorkshopLinksPanel();\n        showCardsView();\n\n        expect(findTermLinks()[0]?.getAttribute('href')).toBe(\n            '/cs/online-workshop/participant?workshop=production-ai-2026-09-10&email=jana%40example.com&fullname=Jana+Nov%C3%A1kov%C3%A1',\n        );\n    });\n\n    it('leads a term of a paid workshop to its Supervize Mini/ });\n\n        expect(paidWorkshopLink.getAttribute('href')).toBe('/ai-supervize-mini');\n        expect(paidWorkshopLink.textContent).toContain('Praha');\n        expect(paidWorkshopLink.textContent).toContain(formatEventPrice(12000));\n    });\n\n    it('leads a term held by somebody else to its organizer, beside the room the member is reading', () => {\n        renderWorkshopLinksPanel([...WORKSHOPS, EXTERNAL_CONFERENCE]);\n        showCardsView();\n\n        const externalConferenceLink = screen.getByRole('link', { name: /WebExpo/ });\n\n        expect(externalConferenceLink.getAttribute('href')).toBe(EXTERNAL_CONFERENCE_URL);\n        expect(externalConferenceLink.getAttribute('target')).toBe('_blank');\n        expect(externalConferenceLink.getAttribute('rel')).toBe('noopener noreferrer');\n        expect(externalConferenceLink.textContent).toContain('Externí akce');\n    });\n\n    it('leaves out a term held by somebody else which names no address to lead to', () => {\n        renderWorkshopLinksPanel([\n            ONGOING_WORKSHOP,\n            { ...EXTERNAL_CONFERENCE, event: { expect(findTermLinks()).toHaveLength(1);\n    });\n\n    it('offers the whole calendar to the calendar application of a member', () => {\n        renderWorkshopLinksPanel();\n\n        expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: /Google/ }).getAttribute('href')).toBe(\n            'https://calendar.google.com/calendar/r?cid=webcal%3A%2F%2Fptbk.io%2Fcs%2Fkomunita%2Fcalendar.ics',\n        );\n        expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: /Jiná kalendářová aplikace/ }).getAttribute('href')).toBe(\n            'webcal://ptbk.io/cs/komunita/calendar.ics',\n        );\n    });\n\n    it('explains an empty list of terms without offering a view of nothing', () => {\n        renderWorkshopLinksPanel([]);\n\n        expect(screen.getByText('Žádný termín není 'Produkční kód s AI agenty zítra',\n    startsAt: '2026-09-11T19:00:00+02:00',\n    endsAt: '2026-09-11T20:30:00+02:00',\n};\n\nconst THIS_WEEK_WORKSHOP: WorkshopSummary = {\n    ...ONGOING_WORKSHOP,\n    id: 'this-week-workshop-id',\n    slug: 'production-ai-2026-09-12',\n    title: 'Produkční kód s AI agenty v sobotu',\n    startsAt: '2026-09-12T19:00:00+02:00',\n    endsAt: endsAt: '2026-09-09T20:30:00+02:00',\n};\n\nconst PAST_WORKSHOP: WorkshopSummary = {\n    ...ONGOING_WORKSHOP,\n    id: 'past-workshop-id',\n    slug: 'production-ai-2026-07-10',\n    title:   serverTime={SERVER_TIME}\n            calendarFeedUrl={CALENDAR_FEED_URL}\n        />,\n    );\n}\n\nfunction findCalendarDay(dayKey: string): HTMLElement {\n    return screen.getByRole('button', { expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: /Produkční kód s AI agenty/ })).not.toBeNull();\n        expect(screen.queryByRole('link', { name: /v červenci/ })).toBeNull();\n    });\n\n    it('colours getWorkshopPhaseAppearance('ongoing').calendarDayClassName,\n        );\n        expect(findCalendarDay('2026-09-24').className).toContain(\n expect.stringContaining(ONGOING_WORKSHOP.title),\n            expect.stringContaining(UPCOMING_WORKSHOP.title),\n            expect.stringContaining(PAST_WORKSHOP.title),\n        ]);\n    });\n\n    it('names a term held today, tomorrow, or later this week rather than only dating it', () => {\n        renderWorkshopLinksPanel([ONGOING_WORKSHOP, TOMORROW_WORKSHOP, THIS_WEEK_WORKSHOP,
